arStrings.szText: "Where is the Cavern of Echoes that Oracle Cyra mentioned?"
South of this village. A strange place. There is a well deep inside. Its reflections are said to reveal truths.
I’ve stared into the well before. I was just a girl, wandering where I shouldn’t. I saw an Amazon staring back. Spear and shield in-hand.
Nostalgic. It is a fond memory
Fitting I should return there. Follow me.
